from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import csv,json,hashlib,sys
base=Path('week09/day06')
out=base/'outputs/layer_support_run01'
read=lambda p:list(csv.DictReader(p.open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='')))
load=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
meta=load(out/'run_metadata.json')
ind=load(base/'checks/independent_run01/verification.json')
tests=load(base/'checks/synthetic_run01/verification.json')
assert meta['exit_code']==ind['exit_code']==tests['exit_code']==0
assert meta['historical_files_unchanged'] and ind['historical_files_unchanged']==1533
assert ind['max_trace_iou_difference']==0
assert all(sha(Path(p))==h for p,h in meta['source_sha256'].items())
assert sha(base/'verify_layer_support.py')==ind['verification_source_sha256']
for p in base.glob('*.py'):
    compile(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'),str(p),'exec')
r=(base/'README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
report=(out/'day06_report.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
pairs=read(out/'all_common_gt_pairs.csv')
asym=read(out/'asymmetric_pairs.csv')
assert len(asym)==31 and len(pairs)==297
scene03=Counter(p['loss_pair_category'] for p in pairs if p['scene_id']=='03')
assert scene03=={'both_lost':1,'IR_only_lost':1,'Fusion_only_lost':9,'neither_lost':59}
for p in asym:
    assert p["stem"]+'/G'+p['gt_index'] in report
assert '7（22.58%）' in r and '23（74.19%）' in r and '1（3.23%）' in r
assert len(read(out/'per_gt_support.csv'))==594
assert len(read(out/'per_layer_support.csv'))==1782
assert len(read(out/'good_candidate_trace.csv'))==4046
files={str(p.relative_to(base)):sha(p) for p in sorted(base.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
dest=base/'checks/delivery_review_run01'
dest.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
info={'status':'passed','exit_code':0,'documentation_read_back':True,'source_syntax':'passed',
      'primary_and_independent_exit_codes':[meta['exit_code'],ind['exit_code']],
      'synthetic_tests':tests['tests_run'],'scene03_categories':dict(scene03),
      'all_31_case_labels_in_report':True,'historical_files_unchanged':1533,
      'file_sha256':files,'command':sys.orig_argv}
with (dest/'verification.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump(info,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
msg=json.dumps({k:v for k,v in info.items() if k not in ('file_sha256','command')},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
with (dest/'run.log').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(msg+'\n')
print(msg)
print('DELIVERY_REVIEW_EXIT 0')
